name: remote-file-manager
description: A visual SSH/SFTP file manager that runs inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Browse and safely manage SSH server files in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Open a visual remote file manager inside Codex. It uses your existing OpenSSH configuration and key authentication, restricts every session to a selected remote root, and requires a reviewed confirmation before writes, moves, uploads, or deletes.
defaultPrompt: Browse files on a server from my SSH config.
Safely edit a remote file with confirmation.
